formats.key: exactInput((bytes path, address recipient, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum) params)
effects: The router pulls amountIn of the first token of the path from the signer (pay → safeTransferFrom) and swaps it through every pool in the path.
The recipient receives the last token of the path, at least amountOutMinimum, or the call reverts ('Too little received').
When the first token is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router wraps the signer's ETH instead of pulling WETH. Extra ETH stays in the router unless the signer also calls refundETH.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; recipient 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
amountIn 0 means the router swaps its own balance and the signer pays nothing.
formats.shown: Swap: amount to send in the first path token, minimum to receive in the last path token, and the beneficiary address.

findings.title: exactInput is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH sent with the swap is never shown.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInput is `external payable`. PeripheryPayments.pay: `if (token == WETH9 && address(this).balance >= value) { IWETH9(WETH9).deposit{value: value}(); ...}`. The descriptor's exactInput fields are params.amountIn, params.amountOutMinimum and params.recipient only. No field has path @.value.
findings.fix: Add {"path":"@.value","label":"ETH sent","format":"amount"}. When WETH is the input, the signer pays in ETH, not WETH, so the screen must show the value.

findings.title: exactInput shows the recipient flags 0x…01 (signer) and 0x…02 (router) as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputInternal: `if (recipient == Constants.MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender; else if (recipient == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);`. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.
findings.fix: Add "senderAddress": ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001"] to the Beneficiary params. Explain 0x…02 as 'Router (held for next step)'.

findings.title: exactInput shows amountIn 0 as '0 <token>', but 0 means the router spends its own balance.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInput: `if (params.amountIn == Constants.CONTRACT_BALANCE) { hasAlreadyPaid = true; ... balanceOf(address(this)); }` with CONTRACT_BALANCE = 0.
findings.fix: Add a message for the 0 value, such as 'Router balance', on the Amount to Send field.

cases.notes: 1020.349 SABAI out matches Amount to Send. 0.000905 WETH in is above the 0.000903 minimum. Beneficiary is the signer.

formats.key: exactOutput((bytes path, address recipient, uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMaximum) params)

The router pulls the needed amount of the last path token from the signer, at most amountInMaximum, or the call reverts ('Too much requested').
When the input token is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router uses the signer's ETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
formats.shown: Swap: the maximum amount in, in the last path token (with 'Unlimited' over 2^255), the amount to receive in the first path token, and the beneficiary.

findings.format: exactInput((bytes path, address recipient, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum) params)
findings.title: exactInput is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH sent with the swap is never shown.
findings.reason: exactInput is payable and nothing checks msg.value. When the input token is WETH9, pay() wraps the signer's ETH and the screen shows it as WETH. For any other input token the ETH stays in the router, and anyone can take it with refundETH. The format has no @.value field. The guide's examples list this as critical, and it is not on the not-critical list.
findings.quote: V3SwapRouter.exactInput: `function exactInput(ExactInputParams memory params) external payable override` (no msg.value check); PeripheryPayments.pay: `if (token == WETH9 && address(this).balance >= value) { IWETH9(WETH9).deposit{value: value}();`; refundETH: `TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(msg.sender, address(this).balance)`. Descriptor exactInput fields: params.amountIn, params.amountOutMinimum, params.recipient only.
